text:
incident-bot: [PAGING] gpu-host-03: driver heartbeat missing; sustained Xid spikes detected (avg 18/min). Auto-evac triggered for affected containers. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/gpu-heartbeat 

alice_oncall: I'm on it, looking at telemetry. seeing lots of Xid 31/43 in the spike graph. any customer reports yet?

ben_infra: telemetry shows repeated `NVRM: Xid 31` and `nvhost reset` in kernel logs for gpu-host-03. 12 containers flagged for eviction so auto-evac did something. I'll cordon the host now.

carol_sre: @ben_infra can you paste `dmesg | tail -n 40` and `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i -A4 "ecc\|reset"` outputs? want to confirm if it's correctable ECC or driver-level resets.

ben_infra: ```
$ dmesg | tail -n 12
[10234.512] NVRM: Xid (0001:0043) - Xid 43, Ch 00000041, engine 00000014
[10234.518] NVRM: GPU at 0000:05:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[10235.102] nvhost: reset issued for gpu 0
[10236.221] NVRM: Xid (0001:0031) - Xid 31, GPU access fault
```
and
```
$ nvidia-smi -q | grep -i -A4 "ECC errors"
Ecc Errors:
    Volatile: 12
    Aggregate: 54
```
Looks like correctable errors ramping quickly.

alice_oncall: starting graceful drain of affected instances (gpu-host-03). switching routing for active inference requests to redwood-dedicated-pool-2. Notifying CS.

customer-success: flagged two customers with active incidents reporting 5-10s latency spikes on embeddings endpoint. Ticket: CS-1832 and CS-1839. We'll communicate mitigation and ETA.

deploy-bot: Canary routing updated: 100% of new requests for embeddings -> redwood-dedicated-pool-2. See dashboard: https://console/redwood/traffic/route/embeddings.

carol_sre: mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain (in progress) 2) attempt driver restart: `sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver.service` 3) if driver reload fails or Xid spikes resume >3 in 10m, escalate to hardware swap. Keep host out of rotation for 30m minimum.

ben_infra: performed driver restart at 5907771260. kernel logs during restart: 
```
NVRM: GPU at 0000:05:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed!
modprobe: unloading nvidia_uvm
modprobe: loading nvidia
NVRM: Xid 31 (after reload)
```
After reload, Xid events dropped off and `nvidia-smi` shows stable temps and ECC counters not increasing for 90s.

alice_oncall: monitoring — no new Xid spikes in the last 3m, latency back to baseline for embeddings. CS updated customers: temporary latency only, no dropped responses. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Auto-evac locks remain engaged. Host gpu-host-03 will remain cordoned for 30m. Please file follow-up work: hw-check + run extended ECC soak test. Suggested ticket: INFRA-3912.

carol_sre: agreed. I'll open INFRA-3912 with logs and telemetry. Recommend removing host from pool entirely if we see any recurrence during soak.

alice_oncall: freeing on-call after 30m watch window if stable. leaving notes on the incident channel. good job team. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: quick note — if packets like this recur but only correctable ECC, we should consider proactive schedule to remap memory or bias ECC scrubbing intervals. follow-up in infra retrospective.

incident-bot: Incident summary: driver heartbeat sputter -> Xid spikes -> auto-evac -> cordon + drain -> driver restart -> stabilized. Status: monitoring, cordon until 30m window expires.
